release_notes:
🚀 v0.1.3 Player Orientation, Stream Deduplication & CDN Normalization
• Offline Playback Landscape Fullscreen: Direct locked landscape fullscreen playback for downloaded media without portrait mini-player
• VidLink & Halo/Nebula Server Deduplication: Streamlined download options and player source selector by deduplicating clone CDN endpoints
• CDN 403 Forbidden Normalization: Automatic fallback & rewriting of partitioned CDN clusters to primary high-availability endpoints
• Subtitle Language Flags & Customization: Integrated ISO 639-1 flag resolution and styled caption rendering
• Cloud Sync & Security Hardening: Tombstone deletion syncing, secret removal, and pre-hop redirect validation
